Select IC50 activity rows for human Phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase catalytic subunit alpha. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary to match the target. Join compound_structures to require canonical_smiles. Join docs to require pubmed_id or doi. Join compound_records to retrieve compound_key. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Filter by standard_type = 'IC50' and standard_units = 'nM'. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
